description: 考研英语一小作文高频题型写作框架模板（告示Notice、备忘录Memo、倡议书Proposal、推荐信、邀请信）

templates.features: 考研英语一高频特色体裁（如招募志愿者、读书会告示、歌唱比赛、辩论赛通知等）

framework.title: NOTICE（居中、全大写）
framework.salutation: 可写通用称呼（如 Dear Fellow Students, 或 To All International Students,）或直接起笔正文

paragraph_1.template: Aiming to [活动目的，如enrich campus cultural life and enhance cross-cultural communication], the [组织者，如Students' Union] is pleased to announce that a [活动名称] is scheduled to be held on [具体日期] in [具体地点].

paragraph_2.purpose: 详细要求、流程安排与参与资格
paragraph_2.template: Detailed arrangements and requirements are outlined as follows: First and foremost, participants are expected to [具体要求1，如possess fluent English proficiency and a keen passion for volunteering]. In addition, the registration deadline is set on [截止日期]. All interested candidates should submit their application forms to [官方邮箱/办公室].

paragraph_3.template:
Everyone is cordially encouraged to actively participate. For further inquiries or detailed schedules, please do not hesitate to contact us at [联系方式] or visit our official website.

The Students' Union

key_expressions: is scheduled to take place on...
All prospective participants are warmly welcomed.
For more information, please feel free to reach out to...

templates.features: 标准公文表头（TO / FROM / DATE / SUBJECT），直奔主题，信息密集高效

framework.header:
TO: All Staff Members
FROM: Project Coordinator (Li Ming)
DATE: October 9, 2026
SUBJECT: Adjustments to Upcoming Conference Arrangements

paragraph_1.purpose: 直接说明备忘录核心意图
paragraph_1.template: The purpose of this memo is to formally inform you of several vital modifications regarding [核心事项，如the schedule and venue of the upcoming international symposium].

paragraph_2.purpose: 罗列具体调整事项与行动指南
paragraph_2.template: Due to unexpected renovations in Building A, the keynote session has been relocated to Hall B on the second floor. Furthermore, the registration deadline has been extended to next Friday at 5:00 p.m. All department heads are kindly requested to recheck attendee lists and confirm their technical equipment requirements.

paragraph_3.template: Your prompt attention and smooth cooperation with these adjustments are highly appreciated. Please submit your finalized departmental reports by no later than Wednesday afternoon.

key_expressions: The purpose of this memo is to inform you that...
Please note that the following adjustments will take effect immediately:
Your prompt cooperation is greatly appreciated.

templates.features: 考研英语一常考文体（如向外国朋友推荐旅游胜地、推荐一本中国好书、推荐优秀人选等）

paragraph_1.purpose: 阐明写信目的与推荐对象
paragraph_1.template:
Dear [Recipient],

    Learning that you are interested in [某一领域/即将来华旅游/挑选书籍], I am writing this letter with great enthusiasm to recommend [推荐对象] to you.

paragraph_2.purpose: 详述2-3条核心推荐理由与特色亮点
paragraph_2.template: My primary reason is that [理由1，如it showcases the profound depth and enchanting charm of traditional culture]. Furthermore, [理由2，如its captivating narrative style and vivid illustrations will undoubtedly offer you an immersive experience]. Last but not least, [理由3，如it provides practical insights that can significantly broaden your horizons].

paragraph_3.purpose: 期盼体验反馈与友好祝愿
paragraph_3.template:
I firmly believe that you will find this recommendation both enjoyable and rewarding. Should you require any further information, please feel free to drop me a line.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

key_expressions: I am writing with great enthusiasm to recommend...
It stands out as an exemplary choice owing to its...
It will undoubtedly offer you an unforgettable experience.
I am confident that it will live up to your expectations.

templates.name_cn: 倡议书 / 倡议信（Proposal / Letter of Appeal）
templates.features: 向广大学生或市民发出倡议（如勤俭节约、垃圾分类、保护传统建筑、读书倡议）

paragraph_1.purpose: 指出紧迫现状与倡议必要性
paragraph_1.template:
Dear Fellow Students,

    In recent years, [指出不良现象或现实挑战，如environmental degradation / excessive food waste] has become a matter of growing concern on our campus. In order to tackle this issue and build a greener university community, we hereby put forward the following proposals.

paragraph_2.purpose: 提出具体可操作的倡议举措（条理清晰）
paragraph_2.template: To begin with, we advocate that every student should [倡议行动1，如practice clean plate campaigns and eliminate food waste]. Moreover, it is strongly advised to [倡议行动2，如utilize reusable containers rather than disposable plastics]. Finally, we should actively disseminate eco-friendly concepts to peers around us.

paragraph_3.template:
Little drops of water make the mighty ocean. Let us join hands from this very moment and contribute our share to a more sustainable campus!

The Students' Union

key_expressions: We hereby put forward the following proposals:
It is of paramount necessity that we take concerted actions.
Let us join hands and make a difference together.
